newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo 1996 pre-tax rises to 1.01 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo 1996 pre-tax rises to 1.01 trln rbls.

text.p: Russian utility AO Irkutskenergo had pre-tax profits of 1.01 trillion roubles in 1996 on an accruals basis, against pre-tax profits of 808.35 billion in 1995, the company said in its annual report.

Irkutskenergo's annual shareholders' meeting on April 5 confirmed the results, which were to Russian accounting standards, and approved a 1996 dividend of 8.59 roubles per ordinary share, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles.
According to company data for 1995, a dividend of 454 roubles and two dividends of 4.54 roubles were paid out last year.
The government is the biggest shareholder in the company, based in the Siberian city of Irkutsk, with a 40 percent share, the company said in November last year.
Brunswick and CS First Boston own about eight percent each, and Baikal Financial House and Energoinvest voucher investment fund own 3.5 percent of shares each.

NOTE -- The profit figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities.
Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
